about.pageSubtitle: Preserving sacred tradition while nurturing a living faith community.
about.paragraph1: Debre Menkrat Kidane Miheret Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church is a parish of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church in Portland, Oregon, dedicated to the worship of the Holy Trinity, the teaching of Scripture, and service to our neighbors. Our liturgy, hymns, and customs connect us to centuries of Christian witness in Ethiopia and beyond.
about.paragraph2: We welcome all who seek Christ — whether you are rooted in this tradition or discovering it for the first time. Here you will find prayer, fellowship, and a path of spiritual growth guided by Orthodox faith.

intro.quote: Rooted in Ethiopia's ancient faith, blossoming in Portland's living community.

mission.title: Objectives of the Congregation
mission.description: As stated in our parish bylaws (Article 5), we strive to:

objectives.1: Preach the gospel to our members to deepen their relationship with God and maintain their life in His path.
objectives.2: Fulfill and maintain the services of the Holy Church.
objectives.3: Increase the number of parishioners, spiritually mature them, and enable them to live a disciplined Christian life with perseverance.
objectives.4: Educate parishioners in the doctrine and history of the Holy Church through special events and community outreach.
objectives.5: Strengthen church administration and pursue self-sufficiency in all directions.

legal.title: Registered Parish
legal.nonprofit: Registered as a 501(c)(3) religious nonprofit organization with the State of Oregon.
legal.taxExempt: The church holds tax-exempt status — charitable gifts may be tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law.
legal.affiliation: An associate of the Holy Synod of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, in matters of spiritual services.
legal.location: We gather for worship at 17021 E Burnside St, Portland, Oregon 97233.

bylaws.title: Church Bylaws
bylaws.description: Download the PDF to read, or open Present on screen for the hall projector or TV.
bylaws.secondaryNote: Also available in the other language.

governance.title: How Our Parish Is Led
governance.description: As set out in our bylaws, the church is led by elected bodies that serve the congregation with accountability and transparency.
governance.note: Parishioners serve without pay; essential clergy and hired staff are exempt from this rule (Bylaws, Article 2).

assembly.title: General Assembly
assembly.description: The supreme body of the church, made up of all members. It meets bi-annually to approve the budget, review reports, and decide major matters.

council.title: General Congregation Council
council.description: The elected executive body that meets bi-monthly to run day-to-day operations, finances, and spiritual services.

rector.title: Cathedral Rector
rector.description: The administrator of the congregation, overseeing the spiritual life and services of the church.

audit.title: Oversight & Audit Committee
audit.description: Three elected members who verify income and expenses and report to the assembly, ensuring financial integrity.

clergy.title: Clergy Services Council
clergy.description: Leads liturgical and spiritual service departments under the guidance of the Congregation Council.

services.title: General Services Administration
services.description: Led by the Vice Chairperson, it coordinates the church's administrative and support functions.
